verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs describe downloading and running LLMs locally through llama.cpp or Apple MLX. They also cover offline document chat/RAG, a local server that only listens on localhost unless you explicitly open it to the network, and voice data that 'never leaves your device'. Community users independently confirm running models locally on their own hardware. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that chat prompts and data (including telemetry) never leave the device during general inference, and independent verification of that claim, which is harder because the app is closed source.
